description.text: All things crypto, random talks with interesting people in the industry about how Web3, the decentralized web, will revolutionize our world.

title.text: So then I Shat in His Cornflakes -- Flu 28:07

description.text: Our friend Flu from Granary Finance ( https://granary.finance/ ) came over for some chat. He's been working with many DeFi projects and has some interesting stories to tell. If you haven't known, Granary Finance is a decentralized, user-driven borrowing and lending liquidity market inspired by AAVE - a decentralized non-custodial liquidity market protocol where users can participate as depositors or borrowers.

title.text: Pod Town stops by the SurPHShop for some fun in the sun with Portalheads, with a party cup full of mayo

description.text: What is SurPH Shop you say? During bear market, Portalheads has seen a lot of fall-off in NFT participants, so they created SurPH Shop , which is a place where everyone can hang out and have fun, get free drops, 1:1 pieces, giveaways, join contests, collaborations... They are currently working on many interesting projects, which were revealed during this episode.

title.text: Some Fine Babbling with Babylon Finance

description.text: Babylon Finance ( https://www.babylon.finance/ ) came over for a talk about crypto investing as well as all the hacks, exploits, bank runs and collapses in the last month. If you haven't already known, Babylon Finance is a crypto investing platform that helps simplify the process by sharing crypto investment opportunities with people that don’t have the time, so you can crowdsource information, split the gas costs and build wealth together.

title.text: One in the Paint is worth two in the Brush, with PaintSwap

description.text: PaintSwap ( https://paintswap.finance/ ), the well-known decentralized finance powerhouse, combining an open NFT marketplace with a decentralized exchange on Fantom Opera Network came over for an episode of Moshi. We'll see how everyone is doing during bear market and catch a glimpse into the future.

title.text: A Little Alpha From a Few Betas with SpookySwap

description.text: SpookySwap ( https://spooky.fi/ ), the all in one decentralized exchange for leveraging diversified funds across ecosystems, our friendly neighbor cat joined us in our latest Moshi episode, about where we are going next and how to navigate when we're at a roundabout. Funny ads included in the episode.

title.text: Hitting the GameFi Multiverse with WARP

description.text: WARP ( https://warp.game/ ) became our latest partner coming from Polygon, launching on Fantom soon. In this episode, we'll have the team over for a chat about Aircraft, GameFi, Multiverse, and more.

title.text: Pod Town AMA - All 'bout Pod Town!

description.text: Town Stage goes live again and this time, we talk about everything on the upcoming Cyber Rabby launch, our move on going Omnichain and where we are on the roadmap.

title.text: Talking all things Sellek and Fantom NFT's

description.text: Moshi Moshi episode 01 has been lived on our Discord Stage, with our beloved podian digdug as a host - and SELLEK as our first guest. He shared how he learned to stop worrying and love the NFTs and everything in the FTM NFT revolution. Sellek ( https://twitter.com/SellekArt ) is a famous NFT artist in Fantom Community. Illustrations and text-based projects with a gritty, handmade look are what he is known for - but you can equally find him doing video-based art outside of the De-Fi space. You may know his collection - Fantom Wheelz and cool arts auctioned in TombHeads Auction House.
